public_upstream.fix_subject: avcodec/dvbsub_parser: avoid signed overflow in the capacity check

oh_source.l4_evidence: dvbsub_parse() capacity guard at line 106 is still the signed-overflow-prone three-term form 'buf_size - buf_pos + pc->packet_index > PARSE_BUF_SIZE'; upstream one-line rewrite applies clean to OH checkout (git apply --check pass 2026-09-22)
oh_source.gap_semantics: version-baseline gap (fix 2026-07-22 postdates the vendored n7.1.1 tag and the repo snapshot); CVE ref list includes the 2005 introducer commit c6ec28b1 which is NOT the fix

vulnerability.summary: DVB subtitle parser capacity guard adds three attacker-influenced ints and can signed-overflow (CWE-190), bypassing the bound so the copy overruns the 64 KiB stack buffer packet_buf (CWE-787); attack surface per CVE record is a crafted WTV file.
vulnerability.verification_level: source-level confirmed (three-sided L4, reference-commit errata documented); runtime observation path documented (ASan stack-buffer-overflow via crafted DVB subtitle stream) but not executed - declared as such
